name: Prom Queen
summary:
In Prom Queen you play a teenage girl who just moved to Queensport, and your dream is to become the Queen of the end-of-year Prom. Yet this does not come easy. You have to use all your social skills and sneakiness, as you navigate the everyday life in Queensport. You want to go to parties, but must not forget your schoolwork! You have to stay popular with your friends and still keep your parents happy!

The world of Prom Queen is filled with exciting places to explore: the Mall where all your friends hang out; your parent’s house; the beach where things go on at night… You will also interact will all sorts of people like your boss, teachers, friends (both friendly, and NOT!) It is just up to you to become this year’s Prom Queen!
